title: Group Chat Assistant
description: Multi-channel assistant for WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord and Slack that answers questions from group history with message-level citations. Uses hybrid vector/full-text search, reranking, evolving decision records, configurable LLM providers and per-group privacy, retention and cost controls.
features: Connect group conversations across WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord and Slack
Retrieve past messages with hybrid vector and full-text search, reranking and citations
Track decisions as they change, including corrections and superseded answers
Enforce per-group permissions, budgets, retention rules and audit logs
workflow: Ingest permitted messages and attached documents
Retrieve, rerank and ground answers in source quotations
Track corrections, decision changes, token use and permissions
